SORT OR STAY - 3D asset library (13 Oct 2026)
Everything here is CC0 (public domain). Each pack keeps its licence file.
Models are FBX (KayKit Prototype Bits is OBJ). Textures are ambientCG 1K PBR:
_Color = Base Map, _NormalGL = Normal Map, _Roughness, _AmbientOcclusion, _Displacement.

PACKS
  KayKit_DungeonRemastered  203 FBX  github.com/KayKit-Game-Assets (new download)
  KayKit_FurnitureBits       53 FBX  github.com/KayKit-Game-Assets (new download, Unity-axis export)
  Kenney_SpaceStationKit     97 FBX  copied from Desktop/Physica Assets
  Kenney_ConveyorKit         61 FBX  copied from Desktop/Physica Assets
  KayKit_PrototypeBits       77 OBJ  copied from Desktop/Physica Assets
  Textures/                   9 sets Carpet015, Tiles107, PaintedPlaster017 (new);
                                     Concrete034, MetalPlates017A, DiamondPlate009,
                                     WoodFloor064, Marble012, Metal063 (from Physica Assets)

FLOOR-BY-FLOOR
Floor 1 - Locked Room (Bubble Sort, intro)
  6 numbered keys ........ Dungeon: key.fbx (add a TMP number label above each)
  key rack / hooks ....... Dungeon: keyring_hanging.fbx, wall_shelves.fbx
  heavy steel door ....... SpaceStation: door-single-closed / door-single-half / door-single
  wall terminal / keypad . SpaceStation: computer-screen.fbx, wall-switch.fbx
  flickering light ....... Dungeon: torch_mounted.fbx, candle_lit.fbx (+ a Point Light)
  walls / floor .......... PaintedPlaster017, Concrete034

Floor 2 - Storage Room (Selection Sort)
  7 crates ............... Dungeon: box_large, box_small, box_stacked, crates_stacked; Conveyor: box-*
  pile table ............. Dungeon: table_long, table_medium
  sorted rack (7 slots) .. Dungeon: shelf_large, shelves
  weighing scale ......... Conveyor: scanner-low.fbx (or scanner-high) - shows the weight
  conveyor ............... Conveyor: conveyor, conveyor-long, conveyor-bars-*
  vault door ............. SpaceStation: door-double-closed / door-double
  floor .................. DiamondPlate009, MetalPlates017A

Floor 3 - Library (Insertion Sort)
  8 books ................ Furniture: book_single.fbx (+ number on the spine), book_set.fbx (decor)
  shelf .................. Furniture: shelf_A_big, shelf_B_large, shelf_B_large_decorated
  reading table .......... Furniture: table_medium_long, chair_A_wood, chair_B_wood
  locked glass cabinet ... Furniture: cabinet_medium (+ a transparent URP Lit pane)
  lamps / rugs ........... Furniture: lamp_standing, lamp_table, rug_rectangle_A/B
  floor / walls .......... Carpet015 (red carpet), WoodFloor064, PaintedPlaster017

Floor 4 - Control Room (Merge Sort)
  monitors / terminal .... SpaceStation: computer, computer-wide, computer-system, display-wall-wide
  server racks ........... SpaceStation: container-tall, container-wide
  tray stations .......... SpaceStation: table-inset, table-inset-small, table-display
  16 data tiles .......... PrototypeBits: cubes (Primitive_* OBJ) or Unity cubes
  floor / details ........ Tiles107 (white tiles), floor-panel*, pipe*, Metal063

Floor 5 - Final Vault (Quick Sort)
  10 items on platform ... Dungeon: chest_gold, coin_stack_large/medium/small, trunk_*
  pivot pedestal ......... Dungeon: pillar_decorated (glow gold when locked)
  blue / red zones ....... PrototypeBits floor pieces, tinted blue and red
  vault doors ............ SpaceStation: door-double-closed
  floor .................. Marble012, floor_tile_large (Dungeon)

Between floors
  stairwell .............. Dungeon: stairs, stairs_walled, stairs_wide; SpaceStation: stairs*
  walls / doorways ....... Dungeon: wall, wall_doorway, wall_corner, column

NOT IN HERE (make in Unity)
  Floating numbers (TextMeshPro), highlights, glass, door slide/rotate animation,
  recursion board (UI canvas on a wall quad), sounds (none downloaded yet).
